title: The Epstein Class Was Made Offshore
gist: Subscriber-gated OnPoint teaser: Harrington frames the impunity of Jeffrey Epstein and his associates as the predictable output of unbridled wealth concentration enabled by the offshore financial system, which she defines as a selective withdrawal from the rule of law that retains all of the law's benefits. She notes the past decade has made previously invisible elite wealth networks episodically visible.

insights.claim: The offshore financial system functions as a selective withdrawal by a privileged few from the rule of law without any loss of the rule of law's benefits — a one-way exit rather than a jurisdictional choice.
insights.speaker: Brooke Harrington
insights.so_what: Frames offshore structuring as a durable political liability rather than a technical tax matter — the argument that underpins future transparency and enforcement regimes.
insights.quote: that system represents the selective withdrawal by a privileged few from the rule of law, without the loss of any of its benefits
insights.locator: The impunity of Jeffrey Epstein and his associates

insights.claim: The impunity of Jeffrey Epstein and his associates is the predictable upshot of unbridled wealth concentration facilitated by the offshore financial system, not an aberration of individual criminality.
insights.speaker: Brooke Harrington
insights.so_what: If elite impunity is structural rather than personal, political pressure will target the offshore plumbing itself — relevant to wealth-management, trust and secrecy-jurisdiction business models.
insights.locator: The impunity of Jeffrey Epstein and his associates

insights.claim: The hush-hush systems through which the rich and famous make powerful connections, exchange favors and hoard wealth and influence were until recently treated as unverifiable — rarely glimpsed, seldom scrutinized and widely believed not to exist.
insights.speaker: Brooke Harrington
insights.so_what: Documented mechanics replacing rumor changes the legal and reputational risk profile of the intermediaries who service these networks.
insights.quote: the hush-hush systems through which the rich and famous make powerful connections, exchange favors, and hoard wealth and influence were akin to a Sasquatch

insights.claim: The past decade has repeatedly and vividly exposed long-hidden networks of wealthy elites to public view, shifting them from conspiracy-theory material to documented subject matter.
insights.speaker: Brooke Harrington
insights.so_what: Recurring disclosure events are a slow-building political catalyst for tax and transparency regulation; treat episodic leaks as regime-change risk, not one-off scandals.
insights.quote: it is as if Sasquatch has periodically strolled out of the woods and posed for a centerfold
